title: 72" Cowhide Leather Laces
description: At 72", these laces made from Cowhide Leather come in either black or brown. Their classic style is perfect for formal dress shoes, boots, and more, adding a touch of class to any outfit. They're flexible, durable, and easy to tie, making them an ideal choice for fashion and function.

title: OK Oil Leather boot oil
description:
Wohlford & Co. OK Oil has long been recognized as one of the finest leather oil for boots in the world. Conditioning and treating your boots to allow them to last for decades.

Developed by Dayton's founder in the 1940s, OK Oil blends natural ingredients which help preserve and extend the benefits of premium quality leather, by protecting the leather and helping it to resist the effects of moisture and water.

Today, the same original secret formula is still carefully mixed by hand in small quantities in the Wohlford  factory store. With regular applications, OK leather boot oil conditions, softens, preserves and protects your fine leather products.

Try a little OK Oil, your boots and all your fine leather products will thank you for it!

Each OK Oil Jar is 4oz in volume, and 7cm tall by 6cm diameter.

Ok Oil will darken the leather when applied.

title: Black Beauty Pre-Order (Deposit)
description:
The Black Beauty to many Dayton customers is the only choice when they refer to their "Daytons". 

This is a pre-order and a deposit only.  Please choose your size using the guidance below.  Please expect wait times of 14-16 weeks.  We will email an invoice for the balance when your boots are ready to ship.

Your order will be CA$295 deposit and final payment of CA$495 pre-shipping.  Both of these charges can be spread over 4-6 payments using KLARNA at checkout.

Included in your Order:

  • 5-6 oz full grain upper leather for fit and durability
  • Goodyear welted construction for superior support, weather resistance, durability and easy resoling
  • Leather lining, insole and heel counter stiffeners for fit and comfort
  • Full length 1/4 inch cork fill for cushioning
  • Steel shank for long lasting support
  • Free Shipping to you.
  • 30 day money back guarantee*
  • Sizing Exchanges*
  • ”til Death do us Part” warranty
  • Commemorative “No Dayton’s Allowed” tee

The Beauty is made on our 8223 western last in E and EEE widths.

* We pay for shipping to you on the initial order.  You pay all shipping cost for returns and or exchanges. 

** we refuse to use leatherboard, cardboard, plastic, fabric/synthetic liners or foam or gel fillers.

title: Beauty Mini Cowboy Boots - Made to Order
description: A shorter version of our classic Black Beauty Cowboy Boots. Beauty Mini – Made to Order offers a more compact size, giving you the same functionality in a more convenient shape. The lower cut shaft makes for easy entry and exit. Beauty Mini – Made to Order offers superior performance in an easy-to-use design. Its shorter size combined with a lower cut shaft provides quicker transitions and precise control.

title: Sidekick - Made to Order
description:
This tough ankle hugging boot with a traditional western toe boasts classic style.

Sometimes referred to as the Granny Boot or the Packer Boot, you'll be amazed at the precision of the white stitching throughout, the Goodyear welted construction, and the full soles to ensure that your comfort comes first.

title: Romeo Wholecut Chelsea Boot - Made to Order
description: Our Wholecut Chelsea is a marvel of craftsmanship. Built on our 11377 last, this boot is made out of one single piece of leather that is formed around the last to create an almost seamless boot. The combination of durability and skilled craftsmanship results in this beautiful Chelsea style boot.

title: Aurora - Made to Order
description:
Durability without compromising luxury is the key component to this sturdy work-horse of a pull-on boot. 

The Aurora Western is the newest style of Aurora inspired by the Carnaby street Chelsea style Beatle boots of the late 60's.

Features include:

• Built on our Western Toe 8223 last

• Made with 6 - 6.5 oz leather

• Elastic gore side panels to allow for easy entry and a snug fit.

title: Engineer - Made to Order
description:
This heavy duty boot for serious riders, strikes a serious chord among its competitors. Bold materials and innovative design has created this boot to withstand extreme conditions, while maintaining the integrity of a comfortable, and easy fit. 

 

Features include:

  • Nailed/welted construction
  • Single top-buckled boot for the 12" boot
  • Functional ankle strap
  • 6 - 6.5 oz leather
  • Full leather midsole
  • Double leather midsole

title: Low Rider - Made to Order
description:
The oil tan leather in these rugged 8" tall boots offer a versatile and unique look made to suit active and fashionable lifestyles. 

Choose between Seidel black oil tan or pull up leathers for a durable, outstanding finish bound to turn heads and incite envy.

title: Rebel - Made to Order
description:
This classic 12" harness boot is one of our most popular styles.  A staple for the rugged, adventurous lifestyles, the riding enthusiasts, as well as the unique, fashionable ones. 

Whether you're mounted to your foot-pegs 24/7 or just want to make an impression, this boot will outlast any excitement you toss at it.

title: Toughie - Made to Order
description:
Sturdy, strength-tested and Dayton Boot-lover approved -- this boot is unlike any other you've ever laid eyes on. 

Walk the pavement in style and roam the great Outdoors with ease - this boot has been crafted to fit a life filled with excitement, risk, and danger while never losing its cool.

title: Driver - Made to Order
description:
The Driver boot has become a Dayton icon, spanning as far back as the 1960's. Strong, resilient, and durable today just as much as it was when it first premiered, you'll soon discover why this model has become an classic. 

Unshakable in its quality, innovative in its timelessness, this boot fits work and play into its agenda. 

Originally designed by the founders’ son for the hardworking milkmen delivery drivers, you'll turn heads while being a part of Dayton history.

Standard features include: 

• Nitrile V bar sole with one leather mid sole

• black chrome leather and white leather heel
• stock D & EE width
• Goodyear welted construction

title: Rider - Made to Order
description: The Dayton 12" Rider is modelled on our original 64 Logger.  Made with 7-7 1/2 Oz. logger-tan full-grain leather, it is built tough to give superior wear and comfort in almost any environment.

title: Parade Boot - Made to Order
description:
Crisp, precise stitching makes this elegant urban lace-up boot versatile in its style and fit. Derived from the army Parade boot, this boot innovates a classic pattern with its silhouette and durable craftsmanship. 

With a sole built and tested for the highest level of comfort and a grip that never fails, you'd be hard pressed to find another boot quite like it.

Specifications:

Black, Brown, or Charcoal Nubuck 

Goodyear welted sole

fully lined

Dayton stamp on quarters

Brogue detail on quarters and toe cap

Vibram 430 mini lug outsole

Biltrite full heel

 *Leather laces shown sold separately.

 

SIZING:

At Dayton Boots SIZE MATTERS. We offer three sizing options; size yourself, remote fitting and in store fitting.

Dayton Boots fit similarly to UK men’s sizing. This typically means one full size down from your standard North American sneaker size. *** IE: NA 8.5 would be a Dayton 7.5.***  Dayton sizing will typically be down 3 full sizes down from a US Women’s sneaker.

If widths options are available, pick a narrow width if you know you have a narrow foot or want a snugger fit.  Or, pick a wider width if you know you have a high instep, wider foot or want a little more room. 

If you already own a pair of Dayton boots or are confident in your size you can size yourself.  Remember your Dayton size is one down from your normal North American sneaker size.  If widths are available, pick a narrow width if you know you have a narrow foot or want a snugger fit.  Or, pick a wider with if you know you have a high instep, wider foot or want a little more room.  Choose: I know my Dayton Size.

If you are unsure of your size but can’t make it to our store we can remotely fit you via our online sizing exercise.  All orders will receive a sizing exercise after purchase.  Choose: I need help with Sizing. (Note $10 service fee)

For in store sizing, place an order by selecting one size down from your normal North American sneaker size and note that you’d like to come into the factory store and have our experienced staff confirm your Dayton size.  Choose: I’ll come into the Original Factory Shop.

title: Aurora Round Toe Boot - Made to Order
description:
The Aurora is a boot inspired by the Carnaby street Chelsea style Beatle boots of the late 60’s.

Add the Vibram Christie sole for a classic Dayton look, or add the Vibram 430 sole for everyday wear.

title: Beauty Cowboy Boots - Made to Order
description:
The Black Beauty to many Dayton customers is the only choice when they refer to their "Daytons".  This was the boot that got banned in Bars all across western Canada and the Pacific North West and garnered Dayton its infamous reputation.

The Black Beauty was originally commissioned 1961 by Charles "Chunky" Woodward, the owner of the Woodward's Department Stores, for himself and his ranch hands at the Douglas Lake Ranch.  This non-decorative western style boot features a single seam straight shaft designed so that neither the rider nor horse is chafed even on long rides.  Originally made with a traditional leather sole, Dayton added the option for corded and rubber outsoles and the black beauty was quickly adopted by the motorcycle community as the definitive riding boot. It is a distinctively functional boot that can polished up for the office or a night on the town.

The Beauty is made on our 8223 western last in E and EEE widths.

Standard Features:
  • 6-7.5 ounce full grain upper leathers for fit and durability
  • Goodyear welted construction for superior support, weather resistance, durability and easy resoling
  • Leather lining, insole and heel counter stiffeners for fit and comfort
  • Full length 1/4 inch cork fill for cushioning
  • Steel shank for long lasting support

** we refuse to use leatherboard, cardboard, plastic, fabric/synthetic liners or foam or gel fillers.

*All images are currently being updated. Some leather and sole options may not be available or at all

title: Ranger - Made to Order
description:
One of our Made to Order boots, the Ranger is based on our original classic logger boot.  It contains all of the sophistication of a durable boot, but with none of the compromise in quality.  Industrial-strength grip, timeless style, and unmatched value - this is a boot you'll find yourself reaching for time and time again.

With our lug sole and lug heel, you'll glide through the roughest terrains to the smoothest of sidewalks with the greatest of ease.

title: Service Boot - Made to Order
description:
The Dayton Service heritage boot is made on our 11377 last based on a vintage Canadian Military design.  Essentially made for the "Everyman" and designed for hard wear and comfortable long use, we offer this in standard E and EEE widths/volumes; more widths are available made-to-order.


Standard Features:

  • 6-7.5 ounce full grain upper leathers for fit and durability
  • Goodyear welted construction for superior support, weather resistance, durability and easy resoling
  • Leather lining, insole and heel counter stiffeners for fit and comfort
  • Full length 1/4 inch cork fill for cushioning
  • Steel shank for long lasting support
  • Bellows tongue for weather resistance

    ** We refuse to use leatherboard, cardboard, plastic, fabric/synthetic liners or foam or gel fillers.
